Definition: Whether the Ministry of Finance has oversight of the financing and development of the digital ID system
Comments: The Ministry of Finance has partial oversight over the ID system funding. The 'Tabioucom' digital stamp duty payment platform (launched August 2024) was jointly developed by the Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Interior, and Post ministry, and chaired by Finance Minister Laaziz Faid. The platform covers stamp fees for ID cards and passports, indicating MoF involvement in ID-related fiscal matters. However, the primary budget authority for the CNIBE system sits with the Ministry of Interior. No dedicated MoF budget line specifically for the ID system was found in public documents.

Definition: Whether credential is accepted or mandatory for registering for social assistance programs and accessing social services
Comments: The national identity card is mandatory for accessing government social services and administrative programs in Algeria. The card is required for all administrative procedures including enrollment in social protection programs. Algeria's food and energy subsidy system (managed through CNAS and other agencies) requires citizens to be registered, which requires a national ID. The imcra-az.org paper notes that social security account numbers are linked to civil status records and biometric identity systems. No evidence found of social services accessible without a national ID card.
